name: Aero Chromatics
description: Wind tunnel simulation where image brightness determines aerodynamic drag, creating chromatic smoke trails.

name: Alpha Crystal Growth Phase
description: Phase-field model of crystal growth with RGBA-packed state. Phase (solid/liquid), temperature, crystal orientation, and impurity concentration evolve together. Creates dendritic crystal patterns with orientation-dependent color. Mouse seeds new crystals; ripples trigger nucleation.

name: Alpha EM Field Simulation
description: Electromagnetic field simulation using RGBA32FLOAT as four data channels: R=E-field X, G=E-field Y, B=magnetic potential, A=charge density. Mouse and ripples inject alternating positive/negative charges. Wave equation propagation with damping.

name: Alpha Erosion Terrain
description: Hydraulic erosion simulation with RGBA-packed terrain state. Height from image luminance is eroded by flowing water that picks up sediment and deposits it in flat areas. Mouse creates rainstorms; ripples trigger flash floods. Alpha tracks cumulative erosion history.

name: Alpha Fire Temperature
description: Fire simulation with RGBA-packed state: fuel, temperature, smoke density, and combustion age. Temperature drives blackbody radiation color. Fuel burns, generates smoke, and heat rises via convection. Mouse injects fuel; ripples create sparks.

name: Alpha Fluid Simulation Paint
description: Full 2D incompressible fluid simulation packed into a single RGBA32FLOAT texture. R=velocity.x, G=velocity.y, B=pressure, A=dye density. Mouse creates vortices and injects dye. Requires f32 for signed velocity and pressure fields.
feedbackPacking: A/C = velocity.xy, signed pressure, dye density; raw simulation state via exact bounded loads

name: Alpha Multi-State Ecosystem
description: Continuous multi-species ecosystem simulation packed into RGBA32FLOAT. Two species compete for shared resources while producing toxins. Species diffuse, grow, compete, and die. Mouse nurtures by adding resources.

name: Alpha Reaction Diffusion RGBA
description: Four-species ecological Gray-Scott field with exact-load state stencils, cross-inhibited warm/cool colonies, three-band mutation pressure, held inoculation, click seed fronts, ACES display, and semantic activity alpha. Raw RGBA chemistry persists in dataTextureA.

name: Bitonic Pixel Sort
description: Workgroup bitonic pixel sort with polar kaleidoscope symmetry, Voronoi ridge sort keys, domain-warped FBM, Halton quasi-random jitter, depth-aware weighting, ACES tone mapping, chromatic aberration, bass-reactive mixing, and temporal feedback.

name: Cellular Automata RGBA
description: 2D ecosystem cellular automaton with four interacting species packed into RGBA. Plants grow from nutrients, herbivores eat plants, predators eat herbivores, and all dead matter cycles back to soil nutrients. Continuous densities enable stable predator-prey oscillations.

name: Chromatic Reaction Diffusion RGBA
description: Two cross-coupled warm/cool Turing systems with exact-load RGBA chemistry, audio-shifted spectral phases, pointer spiral seeding, bounded click fronts, ACES color, and semantic boundary alpha. Raw state persists only in dataTextureA.

name: Chromatographic Fluid
description: Physics Lab — RGB dyes with distinct viscosity in a shared wind field. Hold to paint, click solvent splashes, audio gusts. graph · 7 passes · rgba32float.

params.name: Viscosity Split
params.description: R sticky vs B runny — how hard the dyes chromatograph apart

params.name: Wind
params.description: Shared wind / vane strength (mouse steers; bass gusts)

params.name: Temperature
params.description: Phase change — evaporate hot dye, condense cool solvent

feedbackPacking: A/C = separated dye RGB and solvent temperature; all seven graph dispatches hand off through A only

name: Cymatic Sand
description: Damped Chladni plate simulation with exact-load sand transport, persistent resonance and strike memory, three-band harmonic forcing, held mode displacement, bounded click strikes, ACES grain color, semantic alpha, and raw A-only state.

name: Digital Moss
description: Organic moss grows on dark pixels with spring cursor, held plant/clean modes, capped spore ripples, iridescent palette, scanlines, and ACES composite.

name: Fabric of Reality
description: Living mass-spring cloth — hold to tear, release to watch Self Heal knit seams. Bass breathes the drape; mouse spotlight rides the weave. Tier C graph · 7 passes.

params.name: Stiffness
params.description: Spring constraint strength (soft-capped for stable 4-iter Jacobi)

params.name: Tear Threshold
params.description: How far springs stretch before they tear — lower tears easier

params.name: Gravity
params.description: Downward drape bias (soft curve — no explode at max)

params.name: Self Heal
params.description: Broken springs slowly reconnect when elevated; full heal above ~0.7

name: Ferrofluid Spikes
description: A classic Rosensweig ferrofluid lattice with bounded magnet inertia, held polarity strength, click-launched spike fronts, exact-load viscous persistence, three-band response, honest depth, and studio-lit anisotropic GGX metal.

updatedParams.name: Magnet Strength
updatedParams.description: Rosensweig spike amplitude; bass adds up to +50% and drives the eruption-packet speed.

updatedParams.name: Spike Density
updatedParams.description: Lattice frequency of the Rosensweig peaks; also sets the travelling field-conveyor rate.

updatedParams.name: Fluid Viscosity
updatedParams.description: Damping on the magnet spring and the spike relaxation; higher values slow the snap-back.

updatedParams.name: Highlight Sharpness
updatedParams.description: GGX roughness for the metallic specular lobe on the spike tips.

name: Streamline Pixel Sort
description: Pixel sorting along vector field lines derived from luminance gradients.

name: Galaxy Compute
description: Volumetric spiral galaxy with logarithmic spiral SDF, procedural nebula clouds, Keplerian orbital mechanics, and stellar particle glow.

name: Gray-Scott Tank
description: Physics Lab — true multi-step Gray–Scott reaction-diffusion (Jacobi ×4 / frame). Hold paints V, clicks seed spots. graph · 6 passes · rgba32float.

params.name: Feed
params.description: Gray–Scott feed F (≈0.022–0.058) — spots vs stripes

params.name: Kill
params.description: Gray–Scott kill K (≈0.051–0.065); mouse X biases slightly

params.name: Diffusion
params.description: U diffusion (V is half of U) per Jacobi step

feedbackPacking: A/C = Gray-Scott U, V, reaction age, seed mask; six graph dispatches use A-only handoffs

name: Lenia on Video
description: Continuous Lenia cellular automaton (Chan 2019) seeded and continuously driven by live video. Video luminance seeds the initial cell state; video hue and saturation modulate Lenia's growth center and width parameters in real time, coupling the CA tightly to the subject. Bass beats inject fresh cells from bright video regions. Mouse spawns or clears cells. Outputs a neon bioluminescent CA layer composited over the source video.

name: Lichtenberg Fractal
description: High-voltage electrical discharge with curl-noise branching, depth-aware strike targeting, audio-reactive spread, and chromatic glow (white core → cyan → deep purple).

name: Luma Flow Field
description: Exact-history luma-gradient flow field with iso-luminance advection, curl ribbons, three-band spectral coloring, pointer vortices, bounded click shocks, ACES display, and semantic HDR trail alpha in dataTextureA.

name: Nano Assembler
description: Simulates nanobots constructing the image. Mouse movement disrupts the assembly, scattering the particles.

name: Optical Flow Dream
description: Canonical single-pass optical-flow dream field using exact dataTextureC history, temporal luma gradients, chromatic advection, held pointer vortices, bounded click tears, three-band color, ACES display, semantic alpha, and A-only feedback.

params.name: Flow Scale
params.description: Optical-flow displacement gain from the history ring

params.name: Decay
params.description: Dream persistence — higher holds trails longer (bass lifts)

params.name: Chroma Smear
params.description: RGB split along the flow field

params.name: Dream Mix
params.description: Blend between live input and advected dream

name: Photonic Caustics
description: Temporal caustic pool — move the light, watch chromatic ribbons accumulate. 4 graph passes fit battery; trace×2 under balanced. Tier C flagship.

params.name: IOR
params.description: Index of refraction — steeper pool normals at low values

params.name: Light Size
params.description: Area light radius for photon seeding

params.name: Intensity
params.description: Caustic brightness and accumulator display gain

name: Photonic Caustics
description: Exact-history refractive height-field caustics with chromatic convergence bands, Fresnel response, three-band illumination, held light focus, bounded click wavefronts, HDR A-only accumulation, ACES display, and semantic caustic alpha.

name: Pixel Sand
description: Granular density and velocity automaton with avalanche sheets, rising jet lanes, held-pointer gravity, bounded click shelves, three-band spectral heat, depth shading, ACES display, semantic alpha, and raw A-only state feedback.

name: Pixel Ecology
description: Cellular automata ecosystem with plants, herbivores, and carnivores - watch the food chain unfold.

name: Quantum Foam (Pass 1: Field Generation)
description: Generates quantum probability field with curl noise and FBM. First pass of 3-pass system.

name: RD on Video (Pass 1: State Update)
description: Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion seeded and continuously driven by video luminance, with exact-load chemistry, three-band kinetics, held inoculation, click seed fronts, ACES preview, semantic alpha, and A-only state ownership.

name: Ripple Tank
description: Physics Lab flagship — click for rings, hold for a driven oscillator, audio rains droplets across the tank. 7 graph passes · target 60 fps at balanced.

params.name: Wave Speed
params.description: Propagation speed c of the discrete wave equation (0.08–0.45 world units)

params.name: Damping
params.description: Velocity retention per step (0.975–0.9995) — high values ring for seconds

params.name: Source Strength
params.description: Amplitude and frequency of mouse driver, click ripples, and audio rain

params.name: Boundary Reflect
params.description: Edge behavior: 0 = absorbing shore, 1 = fully reflecting tank walls

name: Sim: Decay System RGBA
description: Four-layer material decay simulation with cross-coupling. Paint integrity, metal corrosion, organic rot, and structural integrity each decay at different rates. When one layer fails, others decay faster. Mouse interaction can restore/repair.

name: Decay System
description: Multi-layer decay and corrosion simulation. Image corrodes from edges inward with different materials.

name: Fluid Feedback Coupled
description: Mouse-steerable coupled fluid simulation combining Navier-Stokes feedback fields with viscous fluid stirring. Mouse drags fluid creating vortex streets; click ripples inject bursts. Fluid thickness drives color absorption, blur, and glow.

name: Fluid Feedback Field
description: Multi-pass Navier-Stokes fluid simulation with feedback trails. Glowing fluid that swirls and mixes.

name: Heat Haze Field
description: Temperature simulation with convection currents. Desert mirage effect with rising heat patterns.
feedbackPacking: A/C = temperature, gradient.xy, refractive activity; raw thermal state via exact bounded loads

name: Sim: Ink Diffusion RGBA
description: Four-ink wet diffusion simulation on paper texture. RGB channels hold cyan, magenta, and yellow pigment concentrations; alpha holds water saturation that drives all diffusion. Pigments mix subtractively on wet paper.

name: Ink Diffusion
description: Fluid ink diffusion with paper absorption. Multi-channel Gray-Scott with Wolfram-validated parameters.

name: Sim: Sand Dunes RGBA
description: Four-population grain simulation packing fine, coarse, moist, and airborne dust fractions in raw A state, with exact-load transport, audio gusts, held deposition, click dust fronts, ACES material color, and semantic coverage alpha.

name: Sand Dunes
description: Persistent dune height field with saltation, angle-of-repose avalanches, wind erosion, moisture cohesion, three-band gusts, held sand deposition, bounded click shelves, ACES shading, semantic alpha, and raw A-only state.

name: Slime Mold Growth + EM Field
description: Physarum slime mold simulation with mouse electromagnetic field interaction. Agents steer along electric field lines; click ripples spawn secondary charges.
feedbackPacking: A/C = trail, electric magnitude, signed magnetic field, growth activity; pointer history uses only extraBuffer[133..138]

params.name: Sensor Angle
params.description: Steering sensitivity and EM charge strength

params.name: Trail Decay
params.description: Trail decay rate and field visualization

params.name: EM Influence
params.description: How much EM field steers agents

name: Slime Mold Growth
description: Physarum-style slime mold with trail following. Branching network of glowing trails exploring space.
feedbackPacking: A/C = trail, diffused nutrient, growth activity, deposit strength; exact Physarum state

name: Smoke Trails
description: Volumetric smoke with vorticity and buoyancy. Billowing smoke rising with natural turbulence.

name: Volumetric Fake (God Rays)
description: Fast approximation of volumetric lighting. Radial blur from light source with depth-based scattering.

name: Slime Mold on Video
description: Video luminance feeds a slime-mold trail simulation with velocity-biased history advection, traveling chemotactic pulse packets, and click food fronts. Audio shifts tendril colors, depth boosts glow, and the mouse deposits food.
feedbackPacking: A/C = trail, video food luminance, encoded drift.xy; exact bounded video-guided state

name: Runge-Kutta Advection
description: 4th-order Runge-Kutta fluid advection. Dramatically more accurate than Euler method, preserving fine dye structures 10x longer. Mouse creates counter-rotating vortex pairs.
feedbackPacking: A/C = un-tonemapped advected dye RGB and flow speed; exact manually reconstructed history

name: Split Flap Display
description: Simulates a mechanical split-flap display where the image is made of rotating tiles.

name: Steamy Glass
description: Simulates a foggy window that can be wiped clean with the mouse. The steam slowly returns over time.

name: Wave Tank
description: Psychedelic ripple tank — click to drop interference rings, drag to stir, bass pulses the waves. Rainbow phase bands and caustic sparkles over your image.

params.name: Wave Speed
params.description: Wave propagation speed (c² in the discrete equation)

params.name: Source Strength
params.description: Mouse, ripple, and audio injection strength

name: Wave Tank
description: Psychedelic 2D wave interference — click to drop ripples, drag to stir, bass pulses the tank. Tier C graph runner demo.

params.name: Source Strength
params.description: Mouse, ripple, and audio injection strength
